objective: Decision 0102: the ForgeGUI lion in game as one whole mesh, skinned to the Stations rig and driven by the existing animation code.
acceptance_criteria: The lion is the ForgeGUI model, one mesh, with no baseplate or stray objects
It walks, attacks, flinches and falls with the same clips as every animal
verification: Lune 759/759, selene clean. Upload-assets run 44622750333 (creature_lion_forge and its rainbow coat). Studio, local build, stamp `dev`, 2026-11-19: the lion loads as one MeshPart with the seven bones body, head, leg_fl, leg_fr, leg_bl, leg_br, tail at the old lion's size (13 studs long); its walk swings the legs 26 degrees each way and its attack rears and lunges; in wave 1 it fought on the team, was named MVP and did its win pose; no see-through faces. Blender renders of bent poses: the tail and legs bend at their joints, the mane turns with the head.
notes: One paid ForgeGUI rig call was spent (job 6dabe42b); its humanoid rig is not used.
